verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.browser-use.com (HTTP 200). It describes the Cloud Agent and Browser APIs and the open-source Python library, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-oriented docs. missing for 10: evidence of a fuller agent-oriented docs set (e.g. llms-full.txt or per-page markdown), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), and independent corroboration of agents actually consuming the docs.
